content: Ollama POST /api/generate: format is 'json' or a JSON schema object; stream defaults true so non-stream needs stream:false; think controls separate thinking output (true/false/null/model strings); options.num_ctx sets context. Empty JSON responses reported when format:json without asking for JSON in the prompt (whitespace + dupe detection). Separate gemma4 issue: think=false with structured format can silently drop format (affects gemma4 line; milestone uses gemma3:4b — treat as adjacent risk for think/format interaction). Provider in this repo defaults think=False, num_ctx=2048, timeout=120.
